title: SudokulousScore
description: Schema definition for a Sudokulous leaderboard score record.

id.description: Application-specific identifier derived from the first six bytes of the score record UUID.

player_name.description: Player name displayed on the leaderboard (1-12 letters).

score_rank.description: Calculated leaderboard rank at time of submission.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level of the completed puzzle.

puzzle_seed.description: Identifier or seed used to generate the puzzle, allowing reproducibility and validation.

mistakes.description: Total number of invalid moves made during gameplay.

hints_used.description: Number of hints used while solving the puzzle.

uuid.description: Universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to the score record.

createdDate.description: The date the score was submitted to the leaderboard.

updatedDate.description: The most recent date the score record was updated.

verified.description: Indicates whether the score was verified by backend puzzle validation.
